nodes.label: laptop memory - the v1 ordering diagnosis

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. Door-trace instrumentation on 2026-07-22 dumped per-pool-chunk door values for tag, desc and scope plus resolve pointers into meta.door_trace, observability only, on both legs at 10smoke k=50. Measured: the pool ceiling recall is 1.000 on every question on both legs, so membership is solved and the whole gap - det 0.775, haiku 0.677 - is ordering inside the pool. Stated scope is the spine, touching about 614 chunks per question, covering 100% of gold chunks at a touched-AUC of 0.82 det / 0.87 haiku, with scope-only chunks carrying 0.27 of recall. The det-leg tag door is dead, touching exactly one chunk per question (the anchor only, because widening never fires when scope fills the pool to k) and never gold, while the haiku-leg tag door lives at 87.7% gold coverage; the desc door is 64-wide at about 62% coverage. The ordering wall is ~0.79-0.80: offline re-ranking of the full traced pools with every principled recipe - normalized convex combination, Borda, corroboration products, sums and tiebreaks, scope-gated variants - caps at 0.7926 det / 0.7999 haiku against the current 0.7751 / 0.7071, with scope-alone the best single scalar, and the remaining ~0.20 of gold sitting low in EVERY door's values. The haiku leg loses to det because cross-part summation drowns scope value under part mass. The VizForce sufficiency cut, kept 16 with recall 0.851 to 0.402, was a CORRECT answer-sufficiency verdict on adversarial-panel replay: all three gold demo URLs sit inside kept chunk 11, and the lost 26 citations are co-cited slack messages carrying no answer content, so the harm is to citation recall, a metric the review cannot see
